questions.subject: maths
questions.prompt: Jack wants to measure the length of his pencil. Which unit is the best one to use?
questions.explanation: A pencil is about 18 centimetres long. Centimetres are a good size for small things.

questions.subject: maths
questions.prompt: Priya carries her school bag to school. Which is the best estimate for the mass of the bag?
questions.explanation: A school bag is about as heavy as a few bags of sugar, so 5 kg. 50 kg is as heavy as an adult.

questions.subject: maths
questions.prompt: Dad fills the kettle to make tea. About how much water does a full kettle hold?
questions.explanation: A kettle holds a few cups of water. That is about 2 litres. 200 mL is only one small cup.

questions.subject: maths
questions.prompt: Liam has two ribbons. One is 15 cm long and the other is 9 cm long. How many centimetres longer is the first ribbon?
questions.explanation: 15 take away 9 is 6, so the first ribbon is 6 cm longer.

questions.subject: maths
questions.prompt: Mia has a 1 litre jug of milk. She pours out 250 mL. How much milk is left in the jug?
questions.explanation: 1 litre is 1000 mL. 1000 take away 250 is 750 mL.

questions.subject: maths
questions.prompt: A kitchen scale has marks every 10 g. The pointer is halfway between 40 g and 50 g. How many grams does the scale show?
questions.explanation: Halfway between 40 and 50 is 45. The scale shows 45 g.

questions.subject: maths
questions.prompt: Ella practises the piano for 2 hours. There are 60 minutes in one hour. How many minutes does she practise?

questions.subject: maths
questions.prompt: Which job is most likely to take about 30 seconds?
questions.explanation: Tying shoelaces is quick, about 30 seconds. The other jobs take many minutes or hours.

questions.subject: maths
questions.prompt: Noah's school camp lasts 3 days. There are 24 hours in a day. How many hours is the camp?

questions.subject: maths
questions.prompt: The digital clock shows 7:48. How many minutes until 8:00?
questions.explanation: From 48 minutes to 60 minutes is 12 minutes, so it is 12 minutes until 8:00.

questions.subject: maths
questions.prompt: On an analogue clock, the short hand points just past the 3. The long hand points to the 6. What time is it?
questions.explanation: The short hand shows the hour, which is 3. The long hand on the 6 means 30 minutes, so 3:30.

questions.subject: maths
questions.prompt: Footy training starts at 5:20 pm and finishes at 6:05 pm. How long is training?
questions.explanation: From 5:20 to 6:00 is 40 minutes. Then 5 more minutes makes 45 minutes.

questions.subject: maths
questions.prompt: A right angle is the same as a quarter turn. Which turn is bigger than a right angle?
questions.explanation: A half turn is two quarter turns, so it is bigger than one right angle.

questions.subject: maths
questions.prompt: At 3 o'clock, the two hands of a clock make a right angle.
questions.explanation: At 3 o'clock one hand points to 12 and the other to 3. That is a quarter turn, a right angle.

questions.subject: maths
questions.prompt: Ava has some 20c coins. She has the same amount as a $2 coin. How many 20c coins does she have?
questions.explanation: $2 is 200c. Five 20c coins make $1, so ten 20c coins make $2.

questions.subject: maths
questions.prompt: Zac has 345 cents in his money box. Which amount is the same?
questions.explanation: 100 cents make one dollar. 345 cents is 3 dollars and 45 cents, which is $3.45.
